title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #8 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did the Prophet say about purity? (1 mark)
   A. It is half of faith
   B. It is a game
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It is not important

2. What does "najasa" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A food
   B. A prayer
   C. A journey
   D. An impurity

3. What is the main tool for removing najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Perfume
   B. Pure water
   C. Paint
   D. Oil

4. Which of these does NOT break wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Urine
   B. Passing wind
   C. Eating and drinking
   D. Deep sleep lying down

5. Which spots are often missed in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   B. The teeth
   C. The top of the head only
   D. The nose only

6. What is the meaning of niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Direction
   B. Prayer times
   C. Intention in the heart
   D. Prayer mat

7. Which prayer has three rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Fajr
   B. Maghrib
   C. Isha
   D. Asr

8. Which prayer is prayed at dawn? (1 mark)
   A. Dhuhr
   B. Isha
   C. Asr
   D. Fajr

9. In which direction does the sun rise? (1 mark)
   A. North
   B. East
   C. South
   D. West

10. What is sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Standing
   B. Bowing
   C. Greeting
   D. Prostration

11. What is niyyah? (1 mark)
   A. Greeting
   B. Intention
   C. Bowing
   D. Standing

12. What do we say in sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Subhana Rabbiyal Azim
   C. Amin
   D. Subhana Rabbiyal A'la

13. How can we help birds in the dry season? (1 mark)
   A. Put out water in a dish
   B. Break nests
   C. Throw stones
   D. Trap them

14. In the Prophet's story, a woman was punished because she (1 mark)
   A. Adopted a cat
   B. Starved a cat she had tied up
   C. Gave a cat milk
   D. Fed a cat

15. Which is a dressing trend to avoid? (1 mark)
   A. Clothes worn to show off
   B. Simple kanzu
   C. Neat trousers
   D. Clean uniform

16. What is a benefit of the Islamic dress code? (1 mark)
   A. Dignity and protection
   B. More harm
   C. Waste
   D. Loss of respect

17. How can too much screen time affect a child? (1 mark)
   A. Makes them taller
   B. Improves health
   C. Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   D. Helps prayer

18. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting others with messages or online posts
   B. Praying
   C. Reading news
   D. Learning

19. What did the Prophet say about the upper hand? (1 mark)
   A. It is better than the lower hand
   B. They are equal
   C. It is worse
   D. It does not matter

20. Which group deserves help? (1 mark)
   A. A person who wants toys
   B. A healthy person who refuses to work
   C. A person who lost his farm in a flood
   D. A person who wants an easy life

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain what integrity means when using a phone. (3 marks)

22. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)

23. Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners. (5 marks)

24. Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog. (3 marks)

25. Give three negative uses of media. (3 marks)

26. How can planting a tree be an act of worship? (2 marks)

27. Explain the rule when you are unsure whether wudhu broke. (3 marks)

28. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

29. Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It is half of faith
   Recorded by Muslim.

2. D — An impurity
   Najasaat are impure things.

3. B — Pure water
   Allah sends pure water from the sky.

4. C — Eating and drinking
   Eating does not break wudhu.

5. A — Heels, elbows and behind the ears
   Wash all parts carefully.

6. C — Intention in the heart
   Niyyah is intention.

7. B — Maghrib
   Maghrib has three.

8. D — Fajr
   Fajr is at dawn.

9. B — East
   The sun rises in the east.

10. D — Prostration
   Forehead on the ground.

11. B — Intention
   Niyyah is intention.

12. D — Subhana Rabbiyal A'la
   Glory to my Lord, the Most High.

13. A — Put out water in a dish
   Birds need water.

14. B — Starved a cat she had tied up
   She did not feed it or let it find food.

15. A — Clothes worn to show off
   Showing off is disliked.

16. A — Dignity and protection
   Modest dress protects a person.

17. C — Wastes time and harms eyes and sleep
   Excess is harmful.

18. A — Hurting others with messages or online posts
   Bullying done online.

19. A — It is better than the lower hand
   The giver is better than the receiver.

20. C — A person who lost his farm in a flood
   Disaster victims deserve help.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Doing the right thing even when nobody sees, because Allah sees and angels record. For example not cheating or copying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for Allah sees, 1 mark for example.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Watching harmful content, wasting time, spreading rumours, cyberbullying, unsafe contacts.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: People or animals eat from it, and this counts as charity for the planter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for charity and 1 mark for eating from it.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: If you were sure you made wudhu and only doubt it broke, you remain in wudhu, because certainty is not removed by doubt.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for staying in wudhu, 1 mark for certainty, 1 mark for the example.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

29. (4 marks)
   Answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.
